description: S3. Devoted Druid with Swift Reconfiguration attached (a Vehicle artifact, not a creature, so -1/-1 counters cannot kill it) on tymna_thrasios's turn (pod n7WpsqsZtdQ), with Walking Ballista as the outlet. The loop: tap Druid for G, put a -1/-1 counter on it to untap it, repeat for any amount of green mana, then Ballista counters and pings. Tests a flagged activation: Devoted Druid carries AI:RemoveDeck:All, so Forge's AI never offers its untap (0 uses in the study corpus). Success: tymna_thrasios wins on the scenario turn.
notes: Reading of the plan's 'an untapper': Devoted Druid untaps itself; Swift Reconfiguration is the enabler the study decks hold (tymna_thrasios lists both, and Commander Spellbook names this pair).

Deviation: Walking Ballista is not in tymna_thrasios's list; the harness places it as a direct outlet so the kill needs no second combo (Thrasios, the deck's own outlet, would need a draw-the-deck and Thassa's Oracle finish). The writer warns; the plan arm's plan data does not know the card.
Opponents hold no instant-speed interaction; every seat at 40 life.
